text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates transit service on the streets listed in Attachment 1 and Attachment 2, City Council approval of this report is required. The purpose of this report is to respond to City Council's direction to review and report back on the feasibility of excluding the development addresses listed in Attachments 1 and 2 from the on-street overnight permit parking program. Transportation Services has determined the proposed realignment of permit parking areas and exclusions are feasible and has no objections to excluding the developments listed in Attachment 1 and Attachment 2. Should City Council approve these realignments and exclusions, residents and visitors associated with the addresses listed in Attachment 1 and Attachment 2 would no longer be eligible to participate in the on-street overnight permit parking program.

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the amendment to Schedule B of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate a revised map of the Permit Parking Areas as shown in Attachment 1 to the report (June 8, 2026) from the Acting Director, Street Permits, Transportation Services, excluding the developments listed in Attachment 1 to the report (June 8, 2026) from the Acting Director, Street Permits, Transportation Services. 2.
